player_prompt.intro:
Tella di tḥemmleḍ deg useqfu s {num_buttons} isebtaṭen: {buttons}. Yal isebtaṭ yesɛa aɣanib n Bernoulli s wazal ameqqran maca ur yettwassen ara; izalen n isebtaṭen zemren ad ilin yemxallafen.
I yal isebtaṭ, mi ara t-tḥemmleḍ, ad t-awḍeḍ tifrat i d-yettwaṣṣaṣen seg wasmil nni.
Ɣur-k {num_turns} tikwal n wakud, yerna deg yal tikelt n wakud, tzemreḍ ad xireḍ isebtaṭ akken ad t-awḍeḍ tifrat.
Taqsiṭ-k d aɛqel ad xireḍ isebtaṭen deg yal tikelt n wakud akken ad tesselḥeḍ talɣut ɣef usmil-nsen n tifrat, i d-yetteddu-k ad t-xireḍ isebtaṭ s wazal ameqqran n tifrat s leḥḥu n {num_turns} tikwal.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ur d-yerri ara umyurar s usebter n tigawt i yellan.
invalid_move.invalid_button: Yettwaferneḍ-d yiwen n tqeffalt ur nelli ara d tin.

game_action.pressed: Tḥemmleḍ isebtaṭ {button} yerna tuɣeḍ tifrat n {reward}.

game_message.final_decision: Tura, ma yella tesεiḍ ayen akk i d-tefkiḍ akken ad tefruḍ deg kra n yiferdisen yemgaraden yerna aţ- ţeẓreḍ amek ara ten-tekkleḍ.
